title: Geologist
description: Company Description Debre Berhan University is a public higher education institution committed to advancing teaching, research, and community service in Ethiopia. The university offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs and promotes innovation and knowledge sharing across disciplines. It aims to develop skilled professionals who can contribute to regional and national development. The working environment encourages collaboration, academic excellence, and continuous professional growth for both academic and research staff. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Geologist role based at Debre Berhan University in Debre Birhan. The Geologist will contribute to teaching and research activities in geology and related earth sciences, including preparing and delivering lectures, supervising laboratory sessions, and mentoring students on field-based projects. Daily responsibilities include planning and conducting field work, performing geological mapping, overseeing core logging and sampling, and participating in drilling-related site investigations. The role also involves applying geophysical methods for subsurface characterization, analyzing geological data, preparing technical reports and publications, and supporting curriculum development and departmental projects. Collaboration with colleagues on research initiatives, community outreach, and consulting projects is expected. Qualifications Strong field skills, including Field Work and Geological Mapping, with the ability to work in varied terrain and weather conditions. Competence in subsurface investigation techniques, including Logging and Drilling, and familiarity with sample collection and documentation. Knowledge of Geophysics methods and tools for data acquisition, interpretation, and integration with geological models. Relevant academic background, such as a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Geology, Geophysics, Earth Sciences, or a closely related field. Experience with geological software (e.g., GIS, mapping and modeling tools) and strong quantitative and analytical skills. Effective written and oral communication skills for teaching, reporting, and collaborative research. Ability to work safely in the field, follow established protocols, and contribute positively to a multidisciplinary team. Prior teaching, research, or industry experience in geology or geophysics is an advantage.

description: Company Description Unique Physiotherapy Speciality Clinic is a dedicated healthcare facility focused on delivering high-quality physiotherapy services to the community in Addis Ababa. Strong communication and interpersonal abilities to work effectively with patients, families, and multidisciplinary teams. Ability to maintain clear and accurate clinical documentation and manage patient records responsibly. Commitment to ethical, non-discriminatory, and patient-centered care, with respect for diverse backgrounds and needs.
